# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [AI-drafted claims push UK employment tribunals to 64,000](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-drafted-claims-uk-tribunals.html): The Economist reports UK employment tribunals are buried under chatbot-drafted claims, with open cases up 55 percent to 64,000 and non-existent statutes cited.
- [Frontier AI safety tests are failing to contain the agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-safety-tests-failing-containment.html): TechCrunch reports that sandboxes used to stress-test frontier AI agents are failing to contain them, turning safety evaluations into a live security risk.
- [Amazon's Texas AI campus cleared for 33M tons of CO2](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-pecos-county-gas-plant.html): A gas plant permitted to serve Amazon's Pecos County data center would emit more carbon dioxide annually than any other US power station.
- [Anthropic makes auto mode the default in Claude Code](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-code-auto-mode-default.html): From August 14 the coding agent stops asking permission per action for Pro, Max and Team users, routing tool calls through a safety classifier instead.
- [Claude Code sessions gain direct messaging across terminals](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-code-cross-session-messaging.html): A new channel lets one Claude Code session hand findings to another over a local socket, with cross-machine exchanges limited to replies only.
- [Grok Imagine Image 2.0 debuts at No.2 in both arenas](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/grok-imagine-image-2-arena-debut.html): SpaceXAI's new image model entered the Arena leaderboards at No.2 for both text-to-image and image editing, trailing only OpenAI's GPT-Image-2.
- [Ling 3.0 Flash sets open-weights efficiency frontier](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ling-3-flash-efficiency-frontier.html): Artificial Analysis scored Ant Group's 124B open-weights model at 38, placing its 5B active parameters ahead of every flash-tier rival.
- [OpenAI slows Astra over first 'critical' cyber rating](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-astra-critical-cyber-rating.html): OpenAI says preliminary evaluations cannot rule out that its unreleased Astra model reaches the Critical cyber tier, and has paused parts of its development.
- [OpenAI, Vercel and rivals ship Agent Plugins 1.0 standard](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/agent-plugins-standard-1-0.html): A vendor-neutral format bundles Agent Skills and MCP server configs into one portable plugin, supported at launch by ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Kiro and VS Code — with Google joining the steering committee the same day.
- [Alibaba launches CosyVoice Studio, a unified voice platform](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alibaba-cosyvoice-studio-launch.html): The Qwen-Audio-based product bundles dictation, voice agents and audiobook generation, and ships free on iOS, Android, Mac and Windows.
- [AMD buys Taalas to etch AI models directly into silicon](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amd-acquires-taalas-hardwired-silicon.html): The Toronto startup builds chips whose metal layers are finalised around one model's weights, promising inference without HBM, advanced packaging or liquid cooling.
- [Anthropic loosens Claude Fable 5's biology safeguards](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-loosens-fable-5-biology.html): A rewritten classifier constitution cut biology-related fallbacks by roughly 85%, after months of complaints that the model refused routine health questions.
- [Cloudflare's Kitesurf drops Chromium for agent browsing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cloudflare-kitesurf-agent-browser.html): The agent-first browser runs in V8 isolates on Workers with no Chromium underneath, claiming 3–7x lower CPU and memory on common agent tasks at 1.7–1.8x the wall-clock time.
- [DeepMind open-sources WeatherNext cyclone forecasting model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepmind-weathernext-cyclones-open.html): A Nature paper puts Google DeepMind's WeatherNext Cyclones ahead of operational systems by over a day of lead time, with code and weights released on GitHub.
- [OpenAI splits ChatGPT tiers between GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-splits-chatgpt-sol-luna.html): Paid ChatGPT users get an updated GPT-5.6 Sol and a five-step reasoning slider, while free and Go users move to the smaller Luna with unlimited text chats.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [AI 代写诉状把英国劳动法庭积案推高到 6.4 万件](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-drafted-claims-uk-tribunals.html): 《经济学人》报道，英国劳动法庭被聊天机器人代写的诉状淹没，未结案件激增 55% 至 6.4 万件，部分诉状甚至援引并不存在的法条。
- [前沿模型安全测试正在关不住被测的智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-safety-tests-failing-containment.html): 有报道指出，用于压力测试前沿 AI 智能体的沙箱已难以有效隔离，安全评测本身正在变成新的安全风险来源。
- [亚马逊得州 AI 园区配套燃气电厂获批年排 3300 万吨](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-pecos-county-gas-plant.html): 为亚马逊得州佩科斯县数据中心供电的燃气电厂，获批年排二氧化碳上限超过全美任何一座在运电厂。
- [Claude Code 将自动模式设为默认，不再逐步征求许可](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-code-auto-mode-default.html): 8 月 14 日起，Pro、Max 与 Team 用户的 Claude Code 默认不再逐个动作弹窗确认，改由安全分类器拦截高危操作。
- [Claude Code 打通会话互通，多终端智能体可互发消息](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-code-cross-session-messaging.html): 新功能让一个 Claude Code 会话通过本地套接字把结论直接传给另一个会话，跨机器场景仅允许回复。
- [Grok Imagine Image 2.0 双榜登上竞技场第二](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/grok-imagine-image-2-arena-debut.html): SpaceXAI 最新图像模型首次进入 Arena 榜单，在文生图与图像编辑两个榜单同时位列第二，仅次于 OpenAI 的 GPT-Image-2。
- [蚂蚁 Ling 3.0 Flash 重划开源效率前沿](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ling-3-flash-efficiency-frontier.html): 第三方评测 Artificial Analysis 给蚂蚁 124B 开源模型打出 38 分，其约 5B 的激活参数量领先所有同档 flash 级模型。
- [OpenAI 首次把新模型 Astra 定为「关键」网络风险等级](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-astra-critical-cyber-rating.html): OpenAI 称初步评测无法排除未发布模型 Astra 达到「关键」网络安全能力级别，已暂停部分研发工作并加码管控。
- [OpenAI 联手 Vercel 等推出 Agent Plugins 1.0 开放标准](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/agent-plugins-standard-1-0.html): 该规范把 Agent Skills 与 MCP 服务器配置打包成一份可移植插件，首发支持 ChatGPT、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Kiro 与 VS Code，谷歌同日加入技术指导委员会。
- [阿里推出 CosyVoice Studio，把语音能力打包成一个平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alibaba-cosyvoice-studio-launch.html): 基于自研 Qwen-Audio 模型，把录音成稿、语音智能体与有声内容创作合为一体，四端上线并限时免费。
- [AMD 收购 Taalas：把大模型直接「刻」进芯片](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amd-acquires-taalas-hardwired-silicon.html): 这家多伦多初创公司在权重冻结后定制芯片金属层，宣称推理系统可完全不用 HBM、先进封装、3D 堆叠与液冷。
- [Anthropic 放宽 Claude Fable 5 的生物学安全限制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-loosens-fable-5-biology.html): 重写分类器「宪法」后，生物学相关的降级回退减少约 85%，此前该模型频繁拒答普通健康问题饱受批评。
- [Cloudflare 推出 Kitesurf：为智能体重造的无 Chromium 浏览器](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cloudflare-kitesurf-agent-browser.html): 该浏览器完全跑在 Workers 的 V8 隔离环境中，官方称常见智能体任务下 CPU 与内存开销仅为 Chromium 的三分之一到七分之一，代价是耗时约 1.7–1.8 倍。
- [DeepMind 台风预报模型登 Nature，代码权重同步开源](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepmind-weathernext-cyclones-open.html): WeatherNext Cyclones 在路径、强度与风场三项上刷新精度，三天预报相当于旧系统两天水平，代码与权重已上传 GitHub。
- [OpenAI 重划 ChatGPT 分层：付费用 Sol，免费转 Luna](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-splits-chatgpt-sol-luna.html): 付费用户全面切换到升级版 GPT-5.6 Sol 并获得五档推理滑杆，免费与 Go 用户则默认改用更小的 Luna，换来文字对话不限量。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-10.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
